items.source: Variant of RequestResponseBodyMethodProcessor(List, List) with an additional ContentNegotiationManager argument, for return value handling.
items.translation: `RequestResponseBodyMethodProcessor(List, List)` 的变体，增加了一个 `ContentNegotiationManager` 参数，用于返回值处理。

items.source: Variant ofRequestResponseBodyMethodProcessor(List, ContentNegotiationManager, List) with an additional ErrorResponse.Interceptor argument for return value handling.

items.source: An @RequestBody method argument is also validated if it is annotated with any annotations that trigger validation. In case of validation failure, MethodArgumentNotValidException is raised and results in an HTTP 400 response status code if DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver is configured.
items.translation: 带有触发验证的注解的@RequestBody方法参数也会进行验证。如果验证失败，将抛出MethodArgumentNotValidException；如果配置了DefaultHandlerExceptionResolver，则会导致 HTTP 400 响应状态码。

items.source: Basic constructor with converters and ContentNegotiationManager. Suitable for resolving @RequestBody and handling @ResponseBody without Request~ or ResponseBodyAdvice.
items.translation: 带有转换器及 ContentNegotiationManager 的基本构造器。适用于解析 @RequestBody 并处理 @ResponseBody，无需 Request~ 或 ResponseBodyAdvice。

items.source: Handle the given return value by adding attributes to the model and setting a view or setting the ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean) flag to true to indicate the response has been handled directly.
items.translation: 处理给定的返回值，通过向模型添加属性并设置视图，或设置ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean)标志为true，以指示响应已被直接处理。

items.source: Basic constructor with converters only. Suitable for resolving @RequestBody. For handling @ResponseBody consider also providing a ContentNegotiationManager.
items.translation: 仅包含转换器的基本构造函数。适用于解析 `@RequestBody`。若要处理 `@ResponseBody`，请同时提供 `ContentNegotiationManager`。

items.source: Complete constructor for resolving @RequestBody method arguments. For handling @ResponseBody consider also providing a ContentNegotiationManager.
items.translation: 用于解析 `@RequestBody` 方法参数的完整构造函数。对于处理 `@ResponseBody`，还应考虑提供一个 `ContentNegotiationManager`。
